facts.fact: Kinshasa's provincial revenue directorate (DGRK) launched irms-dgrk.com on 5 March 2026 for online filing of provincial tax returns, and the business federation FEC says teledeclaration is possible but little known.
The DGRK says irms-dgrk.com lets taxpayers settle tax obligations through several modern payment means.
